description: This file defines functions and utilities related to handling timezone offsets in the Moment.js library, including parsing, formatting, and manipulating timezone offsets.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Defines format tokens 'Z' and 'ZZ' for timezone offset formatting.

methods.name: cloneWithOffset
methods.description: Creates a clone of a moment object with a specified offset, adjusting the internal time accordingly.

methods.name: getSetOffset
methods.description: Gets or sets the timezone offset of a moment object, handling string and numeric inputs.

methods.name: getSetZone
methods.description: Gets or sets the timezone zone offset, inverting the sign.

methods.name: setOffsetToUTC
methods.description: Sets the moment's offset to UTC (zero offset).

methods.name: setOffsetToLocal
methods.description: Converts the moment to local time by resetting offset.

methods.name: setOffsetToParsedOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset based on the parsed offset string or value.

methods.name: hasAlignedHourOffset
methods.description: Checks if the current offset is aligned with an hour boundary relative to a given input.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Determines if the current offset is observing daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTimeShifted
methods.description: Checks if the daylight saving time shift has occurred.

methods.name: isLocal
methods.description: Checks if the moment is in local time.

methods.name: isUtcOffset
methods.description: Checks if the moment has a UTC offset.

methods.name: isUtc
methods.description: Checks if the moment is in UTC time.
